 Josh Wolfe – Caution and Innovation at Lux Capital, Venture is Eating the Investment World 8 (Capital Allocators, EP.236) Feb 21, 2022

 Josh Wolfe is the Co-Founder and
Managing Partner of Lux Capital, a $4 billion venture capital firm
that invests in solutions to the most vexing puzzles of our time.
Josh described his background and Lux’s approach back in 2018 on
the show and that conversation is replayed in the feed.

This time around, we dive into Josh’s cautious perspective on the
venture landscape and how it impacts Lux’s investment process. We
then turn to updates on companies we last discussed and a handful
of “directional arrows of progress,” including smell, deception and
detection, the tech of science, infrastructure for the metaverse,
crypto, elemental power, space, and Africa.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
